name: Tasuku
source:
The main character of this story. A commoner soldier born in Migiwa, who resides in the capital city. He is a young man with a cheerful and honest personality. Although he is considered to be one of the finest fighters of Migiwa, he often only takes part in low-risk missions due to his status and age.
His tsukai is a black wolf named Kotetsu.
